workflows.title: Draft → critique → revise
workflows.description: Create a complete draft, challenge it independently, and revise without an open-ended loop.

workflows.title: Implementation + risk review
workflows.description: Let delivery and risk specialists work independently, then join them into one reviewed plan.

workflows.title: Full-stack app → production
workflows.description: Design and architect the app, define evaluation gates, build in parallel, verify, approve, and deploy.

workflows.title: Secure software delivery
workflows.description: Clarify requirements, review architecture and threats, build test-first, then fan out independent release gates.

workflows.title: Evidence research
workflows.description: Fan out evidence collection, synthesize only supported claims, and gate the result explicitly.

workflows.title: Literature review + gap analysis
workflows.description: Map prior work, challenge claimed gaps, and produce a defensible research agenda.

workflows.title: Bug diagnosis + regression gate
workflows.description: Investigate root cause and blast radius independently before approving a minimal repair plan.

workflows.title: Opportunity framing + decision
workflows.description: Balance user evidence with business constraints and define the next measurable bet.

workflows.title: Feature spec + feasibility review
workflows.description: Reconcile the user contract and technical constraints into one buildable specification.

workflows.title: UX audit + redesign brief
workflows.description: Inspect task friction and accessibility, then produce a focused evidence-backed redesign brief.

workflows.title: Design critique + validation plan
workflows.description: Challenge a design from user and system perspectives before defining the next iteration.

workflows.title: Positioning + launch experiment
workflows.description: Ground differentiated positioning in customer urgency, alternatives, proof, and a measurable test.

workflows.title: Threat model + mitigation review
workflows.description: Map abuse and data risks independently, then gate prioritized mitigations and residual risk.

workflows.title: Security incident response
workflows.description: Triage, investigate, approve containment, recover, verify, and coordinate fact-based communications.

workflows.title: Multimodal asset production
workflows.description: Select and approve a current image, video, or audio profile, generate the asset, then gate safety and provenance.

workflows.title: Image → structured text
workflows.description: Accept a host-provided image, extract text and layout with confidence, and gate the result against the source.

workflows.title: Reference image → new image
workflows.description: Accept a reference image, approve edits and invariants, generate a derivative, and review fidelity and safety.

workflows.title: Coordinated building design
workflows.description: Coordinate program, architecture, structure, MEP, life safety, universal design, cost, and BIM review.

workflows.title: Humanities inquiry + seminar
workflows.description: Read primary material closely, establish its historical frame, and gate a Socratic seminar guide against evidence.

workflows.title: Manuscript development + editorial gate
workflows.description: Separate structural and reader reviews before creating a staged revision plan that preserves the writer's voice.

workflows.title: Values → sustainable action system
workflows.description: Reconcile values and behavior design into a small, realistic action system with humane review and adjustment.

workflows.title: Optimization Problem Solving Pipeline
workflows.description: Takes a natural-language decision problem through formal modeling, routes it to the right solution method by problem class, evaluates solution quality, iterates on the model if the solution is infeasible or suboptimal, and gates final release behind analyst sign-off.

workflows.title: Trigonometric Identity Verification & Tutoring Loop
workflows.description: Verifies a student-submitted trig identity claim, builds an explanation appropriate to whichever outcome (proved or disproved), and loops a tutoring explanation with comprehension checks until the student demonstrates mastery or a max-attempt cap is reached.

workflows.title: Advanced Algebra Proof & Peer-Review Workflow
workflows.description: Constructs a proof for a submitted theorem, runs an independent step-by-step verification, loops revision-and-reverification until every step is valid (or a cap is hit), then gates publication behind a human mathematician's sign-off.

workflows.title: Audio-to-Analysis Pipeline
workflows.description: Transcribes an uploaded audio/MIDI file to notes, branches rhythm analysis by detected content type, runs harmony analysis in parallel, merges everything into a structural analysis, and routes low-confidence transcriptions to a human musicologist before compiling the final report.

workflows.title: Personalized Recommendation Pipeline
workflows.description: Builds a listener preference profile and seed-track feature analysis in parallel, generates and curates candidate recommendations, loops regeneration until a relevance/diversity bar is met, and gates editorial-playlist placement behind a human curator's approval.

workflows.title: Collaborative Co-Composition Workflow
workflows.description: Generates a melodic/harmonic sketch and loops it through composer approval, then fans out into parallel lyric-writing and arrangement, joins the results, checks structural consistency, and loops revision until the piece is coherent.

workflows.title: Physics Problem Solving & Verification Pipeline
workflows.description: Classifies an incoming physics problem by domain, routes it to the matching specialist solver, runs a dimensional/units and numerical sanity check on the result, and loops re-solving with error feedback until the answer passes sanity checks or a cap is hit.

workflows.title: Experimental Data Analysis & Simulation Validation Workflow
workflows.description: Fits raw experimental data and runs a theoretical simulation in parallel, joins them for a goodness-of-fit comparison, loops model-parameter revision until the fit is acceptable, and gates the final conclusions behind PI/advisor sign-off before the lab report is generated.

workflows.title: Demand forecast + independent tie-out
workflows.description: Derive the demand plan twice — once by judgment, once by a declared statistical engine — and gate the planning number on the two agreeing.

workflows.title: Disruption triage + recovery routing
workflows.description: Score live supply exceptions by downstream impact, cut a queue that fits the shift, and route the top band to a costed recovery decision.

workflows.title: Blind screening panel + rubric calibration
workflows.description: Score every candidate blind against the same rubric, then let a teacher model critique the assessors — not the candidates — until the panel is calibrated.

workflows.title: Role opening → ramped hire
workflows.description: Run capacity justification, sourcing, and onboarding design as one ordered pipeline, focusing the ramp-plan phase where the real design work happens.

workflows.title: Account research + claim verification gate
workflows.description: Deduplicate the claim set behind an account brief, verify every claim independently, and block outreach while any claim is still unverified.

workflows.title: Deal desk review + position merge
workflows.description: Let commercial, risk, and forecast reviewers take independent positions on the same terms, then merge them so every disagreement surfaces as a negotiation point.

workflows.title: Ticket triage → resolution or escalation
workflows.description: Classify inbound tickets, filter and rank them by measured impact, cut a queue that fits the shift, and route the top band to a named escalation owner.

workflows.title: Knowledge base refresh + scored review
workflows.description: Normalize article metadata to the canonical taxonomy, curate against the shipped version, and gate republication on a scored teacher review.

workflows.title: Experiment readout + statistical tie-out
workflows.description: Read out an A/B test twice — analyst judgment against a declared statistics engine — and gate the claimed lift on the two agreeing.

workflows.title: Campaign assembly + teacher critique
workflows.description: Produce campaign segments in a declared order, concatenate them without merging, and put the assembled campaign through a teacher critique before brand review.

workflows.title: Close reconciliation + exception register
workflows.description: Extract balances from both systems, merge them declaratively, and drive everything that would not reconcile into a source-tagged exception register.

workflows.title: Two-person review + discordance resolution
workflows.description: Two reviewers examine the same workpaper without seeing each other's conclusion; a vote preserves the tie, and disagreement routes to explicit resolution.

workflows.title: Predictive maintenance call + instrument tie-out
workflows.description: Set a reliability engineer's remaining-life estimate against a declared condition-monitoring run, merge the two, and loop on the assumptions until they agree.

workflows.title: New line qualification
workflows.description: Run FMEA, capability study, and supplier qualification as one ordered sequence, with the validation protocol phase focused on the canvas.

workflows.title: Renewable forecast + reserve tie-out
workflows.description: Derive the generation outlook twice — forecaster judgment against a declared numerical weather-to-power run — and gate the reserve decision on the two agreeing.

workflows.title: Balancing scenario + contingency run
workflows.description: Set the operator's balancing plan against a declared contingency simulation, merge the results so disagreements surface, and loop until the plan holds under contingency.

workflows.title: Fleet record reconciliation + exception register
workflows.description: Extract telematics and maintenance records separately, merge them declaratively, and drive everything that will not reconcile into a source-tagged exception register.

workflows.title: Network incident triage + dispatch
workflows.description: Score live network incidents by network effect, cut a queue that fits available crews, and route severe events to a coordinated response.

workflows.title: Valuation + independent re-derivation
workflows.description: Derive the value twice — appraiser reasoning against a declared valuation model run — and gate the reported value on the two agreeing within tolerance.

workflows.title: Design review + position merge
workflows.description: Take independent code, cost, and schedule positions on the same design package, then merge them so every conflict surfaces as a decision rather than a compromise.

workflows.title: Field signal → prescription with scored review
workflows.description: Normalize mixed field data onto one canonical vocabulary, build the prescription, and gate machine release on a scored teacher review.

workflows.title: Lot trace reconciliation + exception register
workflows.description: Extract upstream and downstream lot records separately, merge them declaratively, and keep every break in the chain as a source-tagged exception.

workflows.title: Property prediction + computational run
workflows.description: Set a chemist's structure–property reasoning against a declared computational run, merge the two, and loop on assumptions until they agree.

workflows.title: Synthesis route → reviewed protocol
workflows.description: Run route planning, characterization strategy, and experimental design in order, then focus the scale and hazard review phase before any protocol is approved.

workflows.title: Blind dual variant read + discordance resolution
workflows.description: Two interpreters classify the same variant without seeing each other's call; the vote preserves ties and discordance routes to explicit resolution before sign-out.

workflows.title: Sequence analysis + scored QC gate
workflows.description: Normalize sample and run metadata to one canonical vocabulary, analyze, and gate interpretation on a scored review of QC and provenance.

workflows.title: Emissions inventory + independent tie-out
workflows.description: Derive the inventory twice — analyst build against a declared calculation engine — and gate the reported total on the two agreeing.

workflows.title: Scope consolidation + double-count register
workflows.description: Extract direct and value-chain emissions separately, merge them declaratively, and keep every overlapping tonne as a source-tagged exception instead of a silent adjustment.

workflows.title: Observation queue + feasibility routing
workflows.description: Score observation requests by science priority and feasibility, cut a queue that fits the night, and route time-critical targets to an explicit override decision.

workflows.title: Measurement + model comparison
workflows.description: Set the reduced measurement against a declared model run, merge them so disagreements surface as collisions, and loop on assumptions until they reconcile.

workflows.title: Land-use claim verification gate
workflows.description: Deduplicate the claim set behind a land-use finding, verify each claim independently against imagery, record, and ground truth, and block publication while any is unverified.

workflows.title: Layer normalization + scored release review
workflows.description: Rename heterogeneous layer fields onto one canonical schema, engineer the release product, and gate publication on a scored review of accuracy and privacy.

workflows.title: Playtest panel + rubric calibration
workflows.description: Score the same playtest evidence blind across three lenses, then let a teacher model critique the assessors until their reads agree enough to act on.

workflows.title: Content beat assembly + teacher critique
workflows.description: Produce narrative, systems, and generated content beats in declared order, concatenate them without merging, and critique the assembled sequence as a player would meet it.

workflows.title: Cut → delivery pipeline
workflows.description: Run editorial, VFX scoping, and colour as one ordered sequence, then focus the finishing and QC phase where delivery compliance is actually decided.

workflows.title: Reel assembly + teacher critique
workflows.description: Produce picture, sound, and finishing segments in declared order, concatenate them without merging, and critique the assembled reel before it is shown.

workflows.title: Line direction + position merge
workflows.description: Take independent trend, materials, and commercial positions on the same line plan, then merge them so every conflict surfaces as a decision rather than a compromise.

workflows.title: Tech pack normalization + scored review
workflows.description: Rename inherited spec fields onto one canonical vocabulary, build the tech pack, and gate factory release on a scored review of manufacturability and compliance.

workflows.title: Coder reliability + rubric calibration
workflows.description: Code the same material blind across three coders, then let a teacher model critique the coders against the codebook until reliability is demonstrated rather than asserted.

workflows.title: Policy claim verification gate
workflows.description: Deduplicate the claims behind a policy brief, verify each against source data, the literature, and the model's own assumptions, and block release while any is unverified.

workflows.title: Documentation claim verification gate
workflows.description: Deduplicate the analytical claims in a description, verify each against attested tokens, corpus evidence, and variation data, and block archiving while any is unverified.

workflows.title: Learner material assembly + teacher critique
workflows.description: Produce lexical, grammatical, and usage segments in teaching order, concatenate them without merging, and critique the assembled material before community review.

workflows.title: Blind dual claim review + discordance resolution
workflows.description: Two reviewers assess the same claim file without seeing each other's determination; the vote preserves ties and disagreement routes to explicit resolution before a decision.

workflows.title: Alert triage + investigation routing
workflows.description: Score fraud and exception alerts on evidenced indicators, cut a queue that fits the investigation capacity, and route the strongest to a full investigation.

workflows.title: Venue and vendor selection + position merge
workflows.description: Take independent logistics, commercial, and safety positions on the same options, then merge them so every conflict surfaces as a decision before anything is signed.

workflows.title: Brief → run of show
workflows.description: Run experience design, production scheduling, and budget control in order, then focus the safety and contingency phase where stop authority is actually decided.

workflows.title: Audit rubric calibration
workflows.description: Assess the same evidence blind across three auditors, then let a teacher model critique the auditors against the rubric until their grading agrees.

workflows.title: Regulatory change → verified obligations
workflows.description: Deduplicate extracted obligations, verify each against the source text, an existing control, and evidence that the control operates, and block sign-off while any is open.

workflows.title: Alert triage → incident response
workflows.description: Score alerts by user-visible impact, drop the ones no action follows from, and route the severe band to incident command with an explicit authorization gate.

workflows.title: Capacity plan + load test tie-out
workflows.description: Set the capacity model against a declared load test, merge the results so disagreements surface, and loop on the assumptions until the plan matches measured behavior.

workflows.title: Manipulation plan + hardware tie-out
workflows.description: Set the planned motion against a declared simulation or hardware trial, merge the results, and loop on assumptions until planned and observed behavior agree.

workflows.title: Blind safety case review + discordance resolution
workflows.description: Three reviewers assess the same safety case without seeing each other's verdict; the vote preserves ties and disagreement routes to explicit resolution before deployment.

workflows.title: Reviewer calibration panel
workflows.description: Review the same manuscript blind against a shared rubric, then let a teacher model critique the reviewers until their standards agree enough to decide on.

workflows.title: Reproducibility + citation verification gate
workflows.description: Deduplicate the claims and citations in a manuscript, verify each independently, and block acceptance while any remains unverified.

workflows.title: Incident intake → dispatch with coverage gate
workflows.description: Score simultaneous incidents by severity and capability required, cut the queue to available units, and route the top band through an explicit coverage decision.

workflows.title: Multi-agency resource reconciliation
workflows.description: Extract each agency's resource picture separately, merge them declaratively, and keep every double-committed or stale resource as a source-tagged exception.

workflows.title: Dispatch release + barrier verification
workflows.description: Verify each dispatch barrier independently — weather and alternates, performance, airspace, crew legality, airworthiness — and hard-stop the release if any one fails.

workflows.title: Fuel plan + independent re-derivation
workflows.description: Derive the fuel figure twice — planner judgment against a declared flight planning engine — and gate the release on the two agreeing above final reserve.

workflows.title: Departure go / hold / no-go
workflows.description: Assess conditions against criteria declared before the decision point, then go, hold and reassess within a bounded limit, or take the pre-planned alternative.

workflows.title: Deferral and maintenance release authority chain
workflows.description: Prepare the deferral evidence in order, check for conflicting work on the aircraft, and route it through an authority chain that cannot be reordered or skipped.

workflows.title: Anti-collision clearance + independent re-derivation
workflows.description: Compute separation from offset wells twice — directional analysis against a declared survey-uncertainty engine — and gate drilling ahead on the two agreeing above the minimum separation factor.

workflows.title: Well control barrier verification
workflows.description: Verify each barrier element independently — mud column, casing and cement, BOP and wellhead, and integrity envelope — and hard-stop the operation if any one is unproven.

workflows.title: Permit to work + simultaneous operations gate
workflows.description: Prepare hazard, isolation, and SIMOPS evidence in order, deconflict activities that cannot run together, and route the permit through an authority chain that cannot be reordered.

workflows.title: Drill-ahead go / hold / no-go
workflows.description: Assess the well against criteria declared before the section, then drill ahead, circulate and reassess within a bounded limit, or set the contingency casing point.

workflows.title: Blind critique panel on a single frame
workflows.description: Four critics read the same photograph blind — light, composition, perspective, technical — their notes stay attributable by dimension, and a teacher model weighs them against the stated intent into a ranked revision plan.

workflows.title: Fix in camera or fix in post
workflows.description: Classify every flaw in a frame, rank by effect, and route each one to a processing recipe, a reshoot plan, or an explicit decision to leave it alone.

workflows.title: Cull, edit, and sequence a shoot
workflows.description: Collapse near-identical takes, score what survives, cut to length, then build the opening, body, and close in order and critique the sequence as a whole.

workflows.title: Grade consistency across a set
workflows.description: Grade a reference frame, have reviewers call outliers independently, tally the calls so a contested frame stays contested, and loop the rework until the set holds.

workflows.title: Commercial delivery gate
workflows.description: Verify coverage, rights, technical specification, colour, and retouching disclosure separately; any one failing stops the delivery rather than being noted in the email.

workflows.title: Development loop against stated intent
